definition.def: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.
examples: The area has its own unique language, Catalan.

definition.def: You can use unique to describe things that you admire because they are very unusual and special. [approval]
examples: Kauffman was a woman of unique talent and determination.

definition.def: If something is unique to one thing, person, group, or place, it concerns or belongs only to that thing, person, group, or place.
examples: No one knows for sure why adolescence is unique to humans. [+ to]
This interesting and charming creature is unique to Borneo. [+ to]
